import numpy as np

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
primary_enrollment = school_primary_df.filter(regex='YR').values
secondary_enrollment = school_secondary_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and primary enrollment
correlation_primary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, primary_enrollment)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and secondary enrollment
correlation_secondary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, secondary_enrollment)[0, 1]

correlation_primary, correlation_secondary

# Extract the relevant columns for economic output
gni_per_capita = gni_df.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_growth = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and GNI per capita
correlation_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and exports growth
correlation_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_growth)[0, 1]

correlation_gni, correlation_exports

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X = np.hstack((education_expenditure, primary_enrollment, secondary_enrollment))
y_gni = gni_per_capita
y_exports = exports_growth

# Create a linear regression model for GNI per capita
model_gni = LinearRegression()
model_gni.fit(X, y_gni)

# Create a linear regression model for exports growth
model_exports = LinearRegression()
model_exports.fit(X, y_exports)

# Get the coefficients for GNI per capita
coefficients_gni = model_gni.coef_

# Get the coefficients for exports growth
coefficients_exports = model_exports.coef_

coefficients_gni, coefficients_exports

# Check for missing values in the datasets

print("Missing values in exports_df:", exports_df.isnull().sum().sum())
